activity.notes: MacLehose assumed duty as Governor on 19 November 1971 and left office on 8 May 1982, after four successive terms. ATLAS uses British Hong Kong rather than an anachronistic sovereign 'Hong Kong' polity.

sources.title: Recording Hong Kong — 1970s, Government Records Service
sources.citation_text: The Hong Kong Government Records Service records MacLehose's assumption of duties as Governor on 19 November 1971.

sources.title: Hong Kong Legislative Council Official Report, 28 April 1982
sources.citation_text: The Legislative Council farewell proceedings document MacLehose's retirement at the end of his governorship in May 1982.
